title: Inspect requirement evolution
statement: As a product manager, I can inspect the complete evolution of a story's definition and lifecycle so I can understand decisions without losing earlier intent.

acceptance_criteria.statement: After a story is revised, querying its requirement history returns both the prior and new complete definitions with their parent relationship.
After a story changes state, querying its requirement history returns both earlier and later lifecycle events, including their states, any recorded reasons, and parent relationships.
